review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: Role: Infrastructure Engineer Day Rate: $650 - $668 + Super Contract Length: 12-months (high chance of extension) Location: Ultimo/WFH Flex We are looking for a senior, hands-on Infrastructure Engineer with broad experience across Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware and enterprise infrastructure environments. This role will suit someone who has worked across a broad technology stack, ideally within a smaller or leaner infrastructure team where they have been responsible for multiple platforms rather than working in a highly siloed environment. You'll be joining a complex enterprise environment with a strong mix of BAU support, infrastructure improvement, security remediation and project work. The Role You'll be responsible for supporting, administering and improving core server and virtualisation infrastructure, with a particular focus on Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware and infrastructure security. The role is expected to be approximately 50% BAU and 50% project work, with close collaboration across Architecture, Cyber Security and wider technology teams. Key Responsibilities Administering and supporting enterprise Windows Server environments Managing Active Directory, Domain Controllers, DNS, DHCP and Group Policy Managing VMware vSphere / vCenter environments Performing ESXi upgrades, patching and lifecycle activities Supporting VMware hardening and security remediation initiatives Remediating infrastructure vulnerabilities, including findings from security assessments and penetration testing Managing Windows Server patching through Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) Supporting and administering Linux environments, including command-line troubleshooting and remediation Supporting Hyper-V environments and workload migration activities Troubleshooting complex infrastructure, virtualisation and server-related issues Managing infrastructure changes through structured ITIL / change management processes Working closely with Cyber Security, Architecture and project teams Contributing to infrastructure design, documentation, implementation and continuous improvement Supporting project delivery across infrastructure upgrades, migrations, remediation and platform improvement initiatives About You You will bring strong hands-on experience across: Windows Server 2016, 2019 and 2022 Active Directory Domain Services Domain Controller administration DNS, DHCP and Group Policy VMware vSphere / vCenter 7+ ESXi administration, upgrades and patching MECM / SCCM for Windows Server patching Infrastructure security, hardening and vulnerability remediation Enterprise infrastructure troubleshooting and root-cause analysis ITIL-aligned change management We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate experience across: VMware hardening and remediation Vulnerability remediation following security assessments or penetration testing Linux command-line administration Hyper-V administration and/or VMware to Hyper-V migration Leading or owning infrastructure projects and major changes Working within complex enterprise environments Producing clear technical documentation, implementation plans and rollback plans Experience in any of the following would also be highly regarded: Linux - RHEL and/or Ubuntu Microsoft Hyper-V Citrix, including Citrix Cloud / DaaS Cisco UCS and/or HyperFlex Server hardware and datacentre infrastructure Beyond the technology, you'll be someone who communicates clearly, approaches problems analytically and is comfortable taking ownership of infrastructure changes in a complex enterprise environment. You'll ideally have a stable employment history and strong experience working across both BAU and project delivery. This role will suit an experienced Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys being technically hands-on, working across a broad technology stack and contributing to meaningful infrastructure, security and transformation initiatives. APPLY TODAY!

review_candidates.description: About Us Veros Credit is committed to making vehicle ownership possible for everyone. Through our vast network of independent and franchise dealers, we have helped countless customers with their financing needs, allowing them to drive off in the vehicle they deserve. We realize that our greatest assets are our employees, which is why we strive to make work welcoming and fun but offer limitless opportunities for growth and advancement. At Veros Credit, you can look forward to company events, free meals quarterly, holiday activities, and more. You will be greeted by friendly, positive, and ambitious team members, and work alongside leaders who encourage and value your new ideas. We are proud to say that it is this sense of community that makes us excited to walk through the door every day. Some of our benefit offerings include: Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Life Insurance Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) Accident, Hospital, Indemnity Insurance Short Term Disability (STD) and Long-Term Disability (LTD) Insurance Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 401(k) Plan Tuition Reimbursement Paid Holidays Paid Time Off (PTO) Transportation Reimbursement Benefit (Mass Transit, Carpool, and Plug-In Electric Vehicle) Referral Bonus Quarterly lunches Daily fresh fruit Office Starbucks Coffee/Latte/Espresso Machine And a lot more! About The Position The Senior System Administrator will be responsible for providing day-to-day support, configuration, and maintenance of all the systems within the IT Infrastructure which includes firewalls, switches, servers, SAN storage systems, VoIP system, Cloud Services, and all business-critical applications. This is an In-Office position located in Santa Ana, CA. Essential Responsibilities: Support IT related projects in alignment with business objectives, evaluate and recommend appropriate technical solutions in the areas of infrastructure and applications, and oversee the management of network security and telecommunications administration. Support and manage the day-to-day operations of all business-critical systems within the corporate office and data center networks by monitoring system performance, configuration, maintenance and repair. Oversee the operation of technology resources (networks, servers, computers, software, and data services). Maintain and administer computer networks and related computing environments including computer hardware, systems software, applications software, and all configurations. Monitor adherence to rules, regulations, policies and procedures to establish and maintain organizational structure. Other duties as assigned. Essential Requirements: 5+ years of Helpdesk support and/or Windows system administration experience. Linux administration is a plus. Experience with Microsoft technologies such as Active Directory, Exchange, and Windows Server. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure AD (Entra ID), Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Storage, and hybrid cloud environments. Proven ability to manage and integrate on-premises Active Directory with Azure AD/Entra ID in hybrid configurations. Experience with cloud infrastructure management, including identity and access management (IAM), security groups, and policy enforcement in Azure environments. Familiarity with Azure networking concepts including VNets, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, and network security groups. Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMWare and Hyper-V and the ability to design, implement and performance tune such environments. Knowledge of cloud migration strategies and experience migrating workloads from on-premises to Azure. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, Bicep, or Terraform is preferred. Experience working in co-located data centers, including the design and standup of new data center. Understanding of cloud cost optimization and resource management practices. Strong analytical and problem solving skills. Ability to interact with others in a professional, tactful, and sensitive manner. Available to work a flexible work schedule, including nights/weekends. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with regularly changing priorities and developing opportunities, both independently and as part of a team. Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience. Salary: $81,000.00 - $102,900.00 annually + Bonus Veros Credit, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. **This Organization Participates in E-Verify

review_candidates.title: Director, IT Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: The Director, IT Infrastructure leads the technology platforms that keep Modern Niagara’s corporate operations running day to day, including enterprise networks, cloud infrastructure, endpoint management, virtualization, identity and access, Microsoft 365, and the broader Microsoft technology stack. Reporting to the VP, Corporate Systems & IT, the Director owns infrastructure as a distinct discipline and provides both strategic direction and hands-on technical leadership. This role is responsible for building and maturing the infrastructure function, establishing technical standards and governance, leading infrastructure modernization, and ensuring the platforms supporting the organization are secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective. Success in this role means a resilient and well-governed infrastructure environment, clear ownership across technology domains, strong infrastructure practices and standards, and a team capable of supporting Modern Niagara’s continued growth and technology evolution. Why This Role Matters to Modern Niagara Infrastructure is foundational to how Modern Niagara operates. The Director, IT Infrastructure ensures that the networks, cloud platforms, devices, identity services, collaboration tools, and underlying technology environments used across the organization are secure, reliable, and available when people need them. This role is also an opportunity to build and mature the infrastructure function. The Director, IT Infrastructure will establish standards, clarify ownership across overlapping technology domains, strengthen disaster recovery capabilities, and lead the modernization of infrastructure and cloud platforms that support the organization’s long-term technology strategy. Key Impact / Purpose Ensure reliable, secure, and scalable infrastructure across network, server, cloud, endpoint, identity, and Microsoft platforms. Establish and mature infrastructure standards, configuration baselines, architecture governance, and change management practices. Lead infrastructure modernization, cloud migration, and data platform enablement initiatives across the organization. Strengthen business resilience through effective backup, disaster recovery, and infrastructure risk management. Build and develop a capable infrastructure team with clear ownership and accountability across technology domains. Partner closely with Cybersecurity, Corporate Systems, Data, and other technology and business teams to deliver secure and effective technology solutions. Duties And Responsibilities Infrastructure & Cloud Own enterprise network and connectivity infrastructure, including routing, switching, firewalls, wireless, and ISP/circuit relationships. Own the Hyper-V virtualization environment and physical and virtual server administration. Own Azure infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, governance controls, and platform architecture. Lead infrastructure modernization, cloud migration, and data migration initiatives across the organization. Establish and maintain technical standards, configuration baselines, architecture governance, and change management standards across network, server, and cloud infrastructure. Build and mature infrastructure practices and standards where formal processes and standards do not currently exist. Identity, Access & Microsoft Platforms Own the identity and access management strategy and execution, including Entra ID, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and Single Sign-On (SSO). Establish and maintain time-bound and conditional access controls for external and third-party data access. Partner with Cybersecurity on identity, access, and security policy requirements. Own Microsoft 365 platform administration, including SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Exchange Online, tenant-level configuration, and migrations. Own Microsoft Intune policy administration, Autopilot deployment, OS imaging and deployment standards, and Autopatch rings. Diagnose and resolve policy conflicts across different endpoint policy delivery mechanisms. Data Platform Enablement Own the Azure infrastructure supporting the organization’s data strategy, including Microsoft Fabric and OneLake architecture. Oversee workspace and capacity administration and the infrastructure supporting Data Factory pipelines and integration runtimes. Ensure appropriate security, identity, and governance controls are in place across the data platform, including RBAC, Key Vault, and Microsoft Purview cataloging and lineage. Partner with the data team to ensure the underlying platform is secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-governed. Provide platform and infrastructure ownership rather than direct ownership of data engineering, pipeline development, or data modelling. Backup, Disaster Recovery & Resilience Own the Veeam backup platform and associated infrastructure. Lead the development and implementation of a technical Disaster Recovery Plan aligned with the corporate Business Continuity Plan. Establish and maintain defined Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs). Identify and address infrastructure risks and single points of failure. Partner with Cybersecurity on backup security requirements, Active Directory hardening, and incident response. Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership Directly manage infrastructure team members and provide clear direction, priorities, and accountability. Define clear ownership boundaries across overlapping infrastructure and technology domains. Build and develop the infrastructure team as organizational and technology scope grows. Partner with the Director, Cybersecurity on shared infrastructure and security priorities. Collaborate with Corporate Systems, Data, business stakeholders, vendors, and other technology teams to deliver effective infrastructure solutions. Provide hands-on technical leadership and participate directly in troubleshooting, architecture, and implementation when required. Must Haves 8–10+ years of progressive IT infrastructure experience, including at least 3 years in a formal leadership or team management role. Deep, current, hands-on experience administering Microsoft Azure infrastructure at production scale, including compute, storage, networking, and governance controls. Deep Microsoft 365 administration experience across SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and Exchange Online, including tenant-to-tenant migrations. Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and OneLake, including workspace and capacity administration, Data Factory pipeline infrastructure, and Microsoft Purview cataloging and lineage. Deep, current experience with Microsoft Intune policy design, administration, and troubleshooting, including resolving conflicts between different policy delivery mechanisms. Proven experience designing and managing enterprise OS imaging and deployment processes at scale. Hands-on experience with Windows Autopilot and zero-touch device provisioning. Direct production experience administering Hyper-V virtualization environments. Strong working knowledge of enterprise networking, including routing, switching, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, and ISP/circuit management. Experience owning or administering enterprise identity and access technologies, including Entra ID, PIM, PAM, and SSO. Experience with enterprise backup and disaster recovery architecture, including identifying and addressing single points of failure. Demonstrated ability to build and mature an infrastructure function, including establishing standards, governance, processes, and clear ownership where they do not already exist. Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Ability and willingness to remain hands-on and engage directly with infrastructure technologies when required. Nice to Haves Experience working in a multi-site or multi-region organization. Experience in construction, engineering, or another project-based industry. Relevant Microsoft certifications, such as Azure Administrator Associate, Modern Desktop Administrator Associate, or equivalent. Experience leading large-scale infrastructure modernization, cloud migration, or data migration programs. This is a new position. Competitive total compensation package, commensurate with experience. Modern Niagara offers a competitive total compensation package including: Defined Contribution Pension Plan with a generous employer contribution Flexible Health and Dental benefits with tiered options to meet the needs of you and your family An annual health spending account to support your overall wellness 24/7 confidential support through our Employee and Family Assistance Program with access to comprehensive resources and professional services A competitive vacation package with additional vacation granted throughout your tenure with the organization Employer Paid Parental Leave Top Up Annual Community Day dedicated to volunteering and giving back to the communities where we live and work Corporate Discounts through various vendors across Canada for programs such as fitness, mobile phones, travel, home and auto insurance and many others Here at Modern Niagara, because we know our people are the best in the industry, we pride ourselves on providing a total compensation package that rewards employees for their hard work and supports employees and their families in their overall wellbeing. About Modern Niagara Who We Are Modern Niagara helps building owners, managers, and general contractors meet the mechanical, and electrical needs of their buildings across Vancouver, Calgary, Edmonton, Toronto, Southwestern Ontario, and Ottawa. We are committed to having a positive and meaningful impact on Canada’s infrastructure — and on the communities where we live, learn, work, and heal. We build for life. Our Culture & Values We value passion, initiative, determination, professionalism, and teamwork. Health and safety are embedded in everything we do, and our award-winning safety culture consistently performs well above industry standards. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Modern Niagara We are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive organization where everyone has access to opportunity, feels a sense of belonging, and can thrive. We actively work to remove barriers faced by members of equity-seeking groups (including women, Indigenous, Black, racialized, 2SLGBTQIA+ people, people with disabilities, and newcomers to Canada) in the construction industry. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and lived experiences and are committed to a barrier-free hiring process. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us at careers@modernniagara.com so we can make appropriate arrangements. We appreciate every applicant’s interest in joining Modern Niagara. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Project Manager
review_candidates.description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role We are looking for an experienced IT Infrastructure Project Manager to manage complex and business-critical projects within enterprise IT infrastructure environments. The Project Manager will be responsible for the full project lifecycle, from initiation, requirements definition, planning, budgeting, and resource allocation through implementation, production deployment, transition to operations, and formal project closure. This role requires a strong combination of project management capabilities and a solid understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure. The successful candidate will work closely with customers, technical teams, solution architects, operations teams, vendors, subcontractors, and senior management. The position provides an opportunity to lead significant infrastructure initiatives and play a key role in delivering reliable, secure, and scalable technology solutions for our customers. Key Responsibilities Manage complex IT infrastructure projects throughout the entire project lifecycle. Define project objectives, scope, deliverables, key milestones, and success criteria. Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, resource plans, and budgets. Take responsibility for delivering projects on time, within the approved budget, scope, and quality requirements. Coordinate multidisciplinary technical teams across infrastructure, networking, systems, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Storage, Backup, and Operations. Manage project budgets and monitor actual costs against approved financial plans. Manage project resources and coordinate internal and external teams. Identify and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, changes, and constraints. Develop risk mitigation and issue resolution plans for challenges that may impact project timelines or outcomes. Continuously monitor project progress and proactively address schedule, resource, and technical dependencies. Manage customer expectations and maintain effective communication with all key stakeholders. Conduct regular project status meetings and prepare structured project reports. Present project status, progress, risks, budget, and key decisions to customers and senior management. Coordinate activities with technology vendors, system integrators, and subcontractors. Manage IT infrastructure implementation, migration, modernization, and transformation activities. Coordinate production changes and infrastructure migrations while minimizing impact on customer business operations. Plan and manage the transition of new infrastructure solutions into production and operational support. Ensure appropriate documentation, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness of support and operations teams. Ensure projects comply with internal standards, procedures, governance, and management requirements. Conduct final project reviews, lessons learned, and formal project closure. Technology and Infrastructure Areas The candidate should have a strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and experience managing projects involving several of the following areas: Server Infrastructure Network and Communication Infrastructure Data Centers Storage Backup and Recovery Virtualization Cloud Infrastructure and Cloud Migration Hybrid Cloud Cybersecurity Disaster Recovery (DR) Business Continuity (BCP) Infrastructure Modernization Hardware and Software Refresh Data Center Migration and Consolidation Infrastructure Transformation Deep hands-on engineering expertise across all of these areas is not required. However, the Project Manager should understand key technical concepts and architectures, communicate effectively with technical specialists, understand dependencies between different infrastructure domains, and translate technical challenges into clear project actions and decisions. Candidate Requirements PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is required. Minimum of 3 years of experience managing IT projects, including significant experience with IT infrastructure projects. Proven experience managing complex, medium to large-scale IT projects. Experience managing projects involving multiple technical teams and infrastructure domains. Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure environments. Experience managing project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, issues, and dependencies. Experience working directly with customers and senior-level stakeholders. Experience managing external vendors, subcontractors, system integrators, and technology partners. Experience coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams. Ability to work effectively across technical, operational, and business teams. Experience preparing and presenting project reports to customers and senior management. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to take ownership of project outcomes and drive projects forward in complex and dynamic environments. Good command of English. Knowledge of ITIL and IT Service Management (ITSM) processes is an advantage. Customer and Stakeholder Management Customer engagement is a key component of this role. Who You Are PMP certification . 3 years of experience managing IT projects, with significant IT infrastructure experience. Proven experience managing complex, medium-to-large-scale projects. Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, storage, virtualization, cloud, backup, and cybersecurity. Experience managing budgets, schedules, resources, risks, and vendors. Strong customer and stakeholder management skills. Excellent communication, leadership, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Good command of English. ITIL/ITSM knowledge – an advantage. review_candidates.title: Ingénieur principal en plateforme (SRE), solutions d'IA/Senior Platform Engineer (SRE), AI Solutions
review_candidates.description: Date: Aug 20, 2026 Location: Montreal, Quebec, CA, H3C 2M1 Functional Area: Remote Syntax is a leading Managed Cloud Provider for Mission Critical Enterprise Applications and has been providing comprehensive technology solutions to businesses of all sizes since 1972. Syntax has undisputed strength to implement and manage ERP deployments (Oracle, SAP) in a secure and resilient private, public or hybrid cloud. With strong technical and functional consulting services, and world-class monitoring and automation, Syntax serves some of North America’s largest corporations across a diverse range of industries. Syntax has offices worldwide, and partners with Oracle, SAP, AWS, Microsoft, IBM and other global technology leaders. ENGLISH Translation is below French. Syntax est un fournisseur de services Cloud gérés de premier plan pour les applications d’entreprise critiques, et fournit des solutions technologiques complètes aux entreprises de toutes tailles depuis 1972. Syntax possède une expertise reconnue dans la mise en œuvre et la gestion de déploiements ERP (Oracle, SAP) dans des environnements Cloud privés, publics ou hybrides sécurisés et résilients. Grâce à de solides services de conseil technique et fonctionnel, ainsi qu’à des solutions de surveillance et d’automatisation de classe mondiale, Syntax accompagne certaines des plus grandes entreprises d’Amérique du Nord dans un large éventail de secteurs d’activité. Syntax possède des bureaux dans le monde entier et collabore avec Oracle, SAP, AWS, Microsoft, IBM et d’autres leaders mondiaux de la technologie. Ingénieur principal en plateforme (SRE), Solutions d’IA (m/f/d) Les équipes d’ingénierie de Syntax se réorganisent en petites équipes (« pods ») composées de développeurs et d’agents d’IA — un modèle qui ne peut fonctionner efficacement que grâce à une plateforme interne solide. Ce poste senior de niveau SRE est chargé de concevoir, développer et exploiter cette fondation : plateformes gérées, modèles de référence (« golden paths ») et solutions d’observabilité permettant aux équipes produit de livrer rapidement et d’exploiter leurs solutions en toute confiance. Vous êtes responsable de la fiabilité, tout en possédant les compétences en développement logiciel nécessaires pour accompagner les développeurs et concevoir des parcours de référence (« golden paths »). Comme nos développeurs, vous êtes pleinement engagé dans l’IA : vous considérez qu’un ingénieur plateforme doit pouvoir produire une infrastructure as code (IaC) de qualité production à l’aide d’outils agentiques, et vous souhaitez être à l’avant-garde des phases de déploiement et d’exploitation agentiques du cycle de développement logiciel (SDLC). Responsabilités Concevoir, développer et exploiter la plateforme de développement Cloud native de Syntax (Kubernetes + CNCF) sur AWS, Azure ou GCP. Concevoir des modèles de référence (« golden-path blueprints ») permettant aux équipes produit d’assurer elles-mêmes le provisionnement, la CI/CD, le déploiement et les opérations. Être responsable du portail interne destiné aux développeurs (par exemple, Backstage) qui centralise les parcours, les services et la documentation. Exploiter la plateforme d’observabilité et de surveillance (Prometheus, Grafana) afin d’assurer la traçabilité nécessaire à une exploitation avec intervention humaine (« human-in-the-loop »). Être responsable de la fiabilité en tant que SRE : SLO, gestion des incidents, performance et automatisation visant à réduire les tâches opérationnelles répétitives. Utiliser quotidiennement des outils agentiques pour produire une IaC de qualité production et repousser les limites du déploiement et de l’exploitation agentiques. Qualifications Expertise approfondie des technologies Cloud natives : Kubernetes et expérience pratique de l’écosystème CNCF. Expérience en production avec au moins l’un des principaux fournisseurs Cloud : AWS, Azure ou GCP. Maîtrise des fondamentaux SRE : SLO/SLI, gestion des incidents, fiabilité, performance et automatisation visant à réduire les tâches opérationnelles répétitives. Solides compétences en IaC (Terraform, Helm, GitOps) ainsi que des compétences suffisantes en développement logiciel pour accompagner les développeurs et concevoir des parcours de référence (« golden paths »). Expérience dans la mise en place ou l’exploitation d’un portail développeur (Backstage) et de solutions d’observabilité (Prometheus, Grafana). Utilisation quotidienne et maîtrisée d’outils de codage agentiques pour produire une IaC de qualité production. Remarque : il s’agit d’un poste de plateforme / SRE nécessitant une expertise approfondie des technologies Cloud natives ainsi que de solides compétences réelles en développement logiciel. Atouts Supplémentaires Contribution à la CNCF ou à des projets open source liés aux plateformes ou à l’observabilité. Déploiement/exploitation agentiques — capacités d’auto-réparation, remédiation automatique ou réponse aux incidents assistée par l’IA. Environnements multi-Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), policy-as-code, sécurité de la chaîne d’approvisionnement logicielle (SBOM) et GitLab CI. Syntax is a leading Managed Cloud Provider for Mission Critical Enterprise Applications and has been providing comprehensive technology solutions to businesses of all sizes since 1972. Syntax has undisputed strength to implement and manage ERP deployments (Oracle, SAP) in a secure and resilient private, public, or hybrid cloud. With strong technical and functional consulting services, and world-class monitoring and automation, Syntax serves some of North America’s largest corporations across a diverse range of industries. Syntax has offices worldwide and partners with Oracle, SAP, AWS, Microsoft, IBM, and other global technology leaders. Senior Platform Engineer (SRE), AI Solutions (m/f/d) Syntax's engineering teams are reorganizing into small pods of developers plus AI agents — a model that only holds up on a strong internal platform. This senior SRE-level role builds and runs that foundation — managed platforms, golden-path blueprints, and observability that let product pods ship fast and operate with confidence. You own reliability, with the software-development skill to support developers and design golden paths. Like our developers, you're all-in on AI — you believe a platform engineer gets production-quality IaC from agentic tools, and you want to lead the agentic deploy and operate stages of the SDLC. Responsibilities Build and operate Syntax's cloud-native developer platform (Kubernetes + CNCF) on AWS, Azure, or GCP. Design golden-path blueprints so product pods self-serve provisioning, CI/CD, deploy, and operations. Own the internal developer portal (e.g., Backstage) that surfaces paths, services, and docs. Run the observability/monitoring stack (Prometheus, Grafana) for the traceability to operate on-the-loop. Own reliability as an SRE: SLOs, incident response, performance, and toil-removing automation. Use agentic tools daily to produce production-quality IaC and push the agentic frontier in deploy and operate. Qualifications Deep cloud-native expertise: Kubernetes and hands-on experience across the CNCF landscape. Production experience on at least one hyperscaler — AWS, Azure, or GCP. SRE fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident response, reliability, performance, and toil-reducing automation. Strong IaC (Terraform, Helm, GitOps) and enough software-development skill to support developers and design golden paths. Built or run a developer portal (Backstage) and observability (Prometheus, Grafana). Daily, fluent use of agentic coding tools to produce production-quality IaC. Note: a platform / SRE role needing cloud-native depth and real software-development skill. Plus Contributed to CNCF or open-source platform/observability projects. Agentic deploy/operate — self-healing, auto-remediation, or AI-assisted incident response. Multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), policy-as-code, supply-chain security (SBOMs); GitLab CI. Why Syntax? Become a part of our success story and work in a company with exciting innovation projects that are causing a stir across the industry. We recently launched one of the world's most advanced manufacturing facilities based on SAP S/4HANA Cloud and SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud for Execution - for Smart Press Shop, a pioneering joint venture between Porsche and forming specialist Schuler. Apply now - and become part of the SYNTAX team! Syntax is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
